Hook and Drive

Catch their guard and haul them into the place they least want to stand.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Brawn

Target / range / shape: One adjacent creature

Choose your target and make the attack.

- Weak: 3 physical damage. - Standard: 3 physical damage; pull 1. - Strong: 5 physical damage; pull 1 and knock prone.

Duration: Instant

Equipment / acquisition: Requires and grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, only if none is owned.

---

Tier / minimum level: 1 · DP: 2 · Requirements to learn: Arms 1

Type: Skill / Attack

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: hook-and-drive
